title: Combinatorial formulas for the multivariate Markov-Krein transform
summary: In this work, we study the Markov--Krein correspondence in both the univariate and multivariate settings. Our main result provides an explicit moment--moment formula expressing the multivariate moments of the inverse Markov--Krein transform in terms of the multivariate moments of the Markov-Krein transform via cyclic interval partitions. We also derive moment--cumulant relations involving classical, Boolean and free cumulants.
